children: NANOBIOTIX ANNOUNCES COMPLETE FULL COHORT PHASE 1 RESULTS FOR JNJ-1900 (NBTXR3) IN INOPERABLE, RECURRENT NON-SMALL CELL LUNG CANCER
ENROLLMENT IN DOSE-ESCALATION AND EXPANSION PARTS OF STUDY IS COMPLETE PER PROTOCOL
FOLLOWING ENCOURAGING FINDINGS, ADDITIONAL PATIENT ENROLLMENT IN THIS STUDY IS PLANNED
ALL 24 PATIENTS COMPLETED JNJ-1900 (NBTXR3) TREATMENT WITH NO DOSE-LIMITING TOXICITIES OR GRADE 3+ ADVERSE EVENTS
GRADE 3 RADIOTHERAPY-RELATED ADVERSE EVENTS IN 33%, GRADE 5 IN 8%; PHASE 2 DOSE SET AT 33% GROSS TUMOR VOLUME
INVESTIGATORS CONCLUDED THAT JNJ-1900 (NBTXR3) MAY PERMIT CLINICALLY MEANINGFUL LOCAL CONTROL USING A SUBSTANTIALLY LOWER RE-IRRADIATION DOSE
AT 12-MONTH FOLLOW-UP (AUG 2026), ONE-YEAR LOCOREGIONAL CONTROL RATE WAS 79%, LOCAL PROGRESSION-FREE SURVIVAL (LPFS) 61%, OVERALL SURVIVAL (OS) 70%
